name: Copilot cloud agent: idempotency keys for the refunds endpoint
description: A developer delegates a coding task to the Copilot cloud agent. All clarifying answers arrive in one `.answers` comment (Q1 falls back to its default). A payments-api maintainer approves; execution creates an issue in the target repository assigned to Copilot with rendered custom instructions, and the agent opens a draft pull request there.

issue.title: [IssueOps] Agentic task: idempotency keys for POST /refunds

values.agent_objective: Retries from the mobile app occasionally create duplicate refunds. Add Idempotency-Key header support to POST /v2/refunds, persisting keys for 24 hours and returning the original response for duplicates.
values.agent_acceptance_criteria:
- Duplicate requests with the same key return the original 201 response
- Keys expire after 24 hours
- Unit and integration tests cover duplicate, expired and missing keys
- OpenAPI spec updated

selected: I will review all agent output (pull requests, documents) before it is merged or relied on
The objective and answers contain no secrets, credentials, or personal data

steps.body:
.answers
A2: src/main/java/com/coolengorg/payments/refunds/**, src/main/resources/openapi/refunds.yaml
A3: Do not change the ledger module or database migrations other than adding the idempotency table
A4: ./gradlew test integrationTest
A5: skip

steps.note: write permission is not enough: the rule needs maintain or admin on the target repository.
